literature_notes: PMEPA1/TMEPAI is a single-pass membrane protein with its only extracellular span at residues 1–43 (N-terminal ectodomain, 43 aa) and a long intracellular tail (63–287). Every tag insertion reported in the ledger is at the intracellular C-terminus (residue 287, Flag in L2; V5 in L4 and L5). L1 describes Flag-tagged full-length constructs carrying intracellular deletions (Δ63–86 and Δ132–155) but does not state where the Flag tag itself is placed, and both deletion regions are intracellular. L3 reports localization of a deletion mutant (Δ132–155), not a surface tag insertion. No ledger line reports a tolerated epitope-tag insertion, fluorescent-protein fusion, transposon hit, or any other qualifying insertion on the extracellular face of this protein. Zero surface tag sites are therefore supported.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal Flag tag on full-length TMEPAI (TMEPAI-2YA-Flag, TMEPAI-KR-Flag); residue 287 is the last residue of the intracellular tail (topology 63–287).
C-terminal V5 tag on full-length TMEPAI; residue 287 is intracellular.
Deletion mutant Δ63–86 (start of intracellular tail) expressed and localized in A549 cells; region is entirely intracellular.

Deletion of aa132–155 (dynactin-binding region, intracellular) disrupts dynactin binding and alters intracellular trafficking, causing retention at the plasma membrane rather than endosomal compartments.
